bkash.label: bKash
bkash.instructions:
1. Open the Bkash app
2. Tap 'Send Money'
3. Enter the Bkash number above
4. Send the exact amount
5. Copy the Transaction ID (TrxID)

binance.label: Binance Pay
binance.instructions:
1. Open the Binance app
2. Tap 'Pay' -> Send
3. Enter the Binance Pay ID above
4. Send the exact USDT amount shown
5. Take a screenshot of the payment

btc.label: Bitcoin (BTC)
btc.instructions:
1. Open your crypto wallet
2. Send the exact BTC amount shown
3. Use the Bitcoin (BTC) network only
4. Take a screenshot of the transaction
